Placement keep-outs (soft, density cap) in the rows outside each CFGMEM column's tile-facing edge at the pair gaps: every stalled route died there (see docs 4z.6)
//stripes: Project.ExtendPowerStripes: the SRAMs get the tile grid's stripes moved onto their own supply columns plus complete pairs per region, and (EXTEND_STRIPES_SRAM_ARRAY_EVERY_OTHER) a VPWR/VGND pair on every other pair position of each bit-cell array, with the band's outer pairs from the grid moves; no SRAM column stripe lands within 0.5 um of a macro's Metal4 signal pin, and one crossing an SRAM-aligned macro (CFGMEMS_LEFT[1].cfgmem_lo as CFGMEM_IHP_LEFT16_SRAM, see //swap) lands on one of its rails.  Result per SRAM: array L 8 pairs, band 2, array R 7, all 24 stripes across that macro on its rails (the plain LEFT16 there got 4 of its 15 rails fed).  CFGMEMS_LEFT[1].cfgmem_lo sits at the top left by the tile pins (the band layout, x 132.47).  runs/sram16 (2026-09-26) signed off with exactly this config.

pdn_cfg.tcl is LibreLane's PDN config without the per-macro grid, which has no shapes with this single-layer PDN and makes an unpatched pdngen fail (PDN-0233); the macros get their power from Project.ExtendPowerStripes
